name: keepassxc-search
description: Look up logins in KeePassXC and open SSH / RDP / Telnet sessions from electerm

electerm.name: KeePassXC Search
electerm.description: Passwords from KeePassXC: SSH and RDP bookmarks without a saved password get user name and password from the KeePassXC entry for ssh://host:port or rdp://host:port, and a new login is saved there once it worked. The panel also searches by host or URL and opens sessions. Talks to KeePassXC through its browser integration.

configs.name: query
configs.label: Host or URL
configs.description: A host is looked up as ssh://host:22, rdp://host:3389, telnet://host:23 and https://host (an entry with only the host as URL). Empty: show the pairing.
